run.target: PAR-23/24 W1 search, bulk operations, export and import task lifecycle
run.runtime: not-acquired: development slots occupied by crm-w1-contact-t05 and crm-w1-opportunity-t07

groups.title: Global, advanced and personal search with permission and masking

rows.action: Global record search builds navigation from public pid and rejects internal-id-only rows
rows.assertion: pid creates a public detail path; id-only input returns null

rows.action: Global search returns only menu-visible, data-scope-authorized and masked CRM records for a non-admin role
rows.assertion: seeded permitted record is visible, denied record is absent, sensitive fields remain masked, direct detail URL stays denied

rows.action: Account advanced filter supports nested conditions and persists URL/reload state
rows.assertion: AND/OR filter result, request filters payload and reload result match seeded accounts

rows.action: Account personal saved view is owner-scoped, reloadable and removable
rows.assertion: saved filter reappears for owner after reload and remains absent for another user

rows.action: Lead advanced/personal search with data scope and masking
rows.assertion: lead-specific search journey and permission negative

rows.action: Contact advanced/personal search with channel masking
rows.assertion: contact-specific search journey and masked phone/email result

rows.action: Opportunity advanced/personal search with data scope
rows.assertion: opportunity-specific search journey and permission negative

groups.title: Batch transfer/edit/delete and selected/all matching export

rows.action: Transfer selected accounts and verify ownership, old-owner denial and audit
rows.assertion: selected pids change owner exactly once and permissions recalculate after reload

rows.action: Edit an allowed field across selected accounts and reject state-machine fields
rows.assertion: all selected rows persist the value after reload and forbidden fields are absent

rows.action: Delete selected accounts with confirmation and permission failure atomicity
rows.assertion: authorized selection disappears; mixed unauthorized selection does not silently partially delete

rows.action: Export selected accounts and parse downloaded workbook
rows.assertion: filename/header/non-empty bytes and parsed rows equal selected public records with masking applied

rows.action: Export all matching accounts across pages with exclusions and parse workbook
rows.assertion: parsed workbook row count and keys match filtered denominator minus exclusions, not only current page

rows.action: Lead transfer/edit/delete and selected/all matching export
rows.assertion: object-specific persistence, permission and parsed artifact checks

rows.action: Contact transfer/edit/delete and selected/all matching export
rows.assertion: object-specific persistence, permission, channel masking and parsed artifact checks

rows.action: Opportunity transfer/edit/delete and selected/all matching export
rows.assertion: object-specific persistence, permission and parsed artifact checks

groups.title: Import template, preflight, failure report, cancellation, retry and capacity

rows.action: Cancel API delegates the public task id and retains dynamic model import permission
rows.assertion: route, model/task delegation, fail-closed unknown task and model.{modelCode}.import annotation

rows.action: Restore a cancelled task with full denominator and truthful partial counts
rows.assertion: status=cancelled, total=10000, processed=503, success=500, error=3 and hasErrors=true

rows.action: Reject cancellation of a terminal task without rewriting import history
rows.assertion: completed task cancellation raises a business error and performs no update

rows.action: Failed import exposes explicit retry and reuses the validated source file
rows.assertion: first execution failure shows Retry import; second execution succeeds without reselecting file

rows.action: Running import exposes an explicit cancel control and returns the same file to retry state
rows.assertion: cancel request targets the active task, shows cooperative-cancellation feedback and then exposes Retry import

rows.action: Download template, parse headers/instructions, preflight invalid rows and parse correction workbook
rows.assertion: menu-driven browser journey parses both template and failure report contents

rows.action: Cancel a running import from UI and verify persisted partial counts and no later writes
rows.assertion: cancel endpoint is owner-scoped; DB count stops at processedRows and remains stable

rows.action: Retry a failed/cancelled import from UI and verify idempotent persistence semantics
rows.assertion: retry persists the intended rows without duplicating already committed records

rows.action: Validate import failure rollback and partial-row policy against persisted CRM data
rows.assertion: preflight writes nothing; rejected row writes nothing; accepted prior rows match declared skipErrors semantics

rows.action: 10,000-row search/import/export capacity denominator
rows.assertion: 10,000 seeded rows remain permission-correct and complete within an approved latency budget

rows.action: 100,000-row search/import/export capacity denominator
rows.assertion: 100,000 seeded rows remain permission-correct and complete within an approved latency budget
